summary: The core of the finding is fixed. Since #710 (60633eff3), useSettings uses a selector-aware useSyncExternalStore with Object.is over a merged-settings snapshot cached per (server settings, client settings) pair. Provider-status pushes keep config.settings, so useSettings consumers (SidebarProjectItem, InboxThreadRow, useGitStatus) no longer re-render on them, and a browser test covers this. The amplifier the finding also named is not removed for provider-status pushes. Sidebar's inbox model now depends on config.providers instead of the whole config. Every provider delta creates a new providers array, so it still rebuilds the whole inbox model (buildInboxSidebarModel over all threads) and re-renders every inbox row, and inbox is the default sidebar mode. The model only needs provider.driver and provider.models, for the model label, and status-only deltas keep the models array identity. ProjectFavicon still subscribes to the whole serverConfigAtom; the auditor missed it. It renders in every non-resting inbox row and every sidebar project header. DeviceIcon and ThreadPriorityRefreshBridge also still re-render or re-run on every provider push. Boot pushes are now much rarer (#710 persists fingerprinted probe results, and the server debounces and dedupes deltas), so the remaining cost shows up mainly after server or binary updates, provider settings changes and explicit refreshes.

evidence.note: Fixed. mergeSettings is cached in a WeakMap keyed by (ServerSettings, ClientSettings). useSettings subscribes to serverConfigAtom and client settings and selects through useSyncExternalStoreSelector, so re-renders follow the selected value. The doc comment is now accurate.
The selection is memoized per snapshot and keeps the previous value under isEqual. Inline selectors (a new reader per render) stay correct and do not loop.
Profiler test: two provider pushes and an unrelated setting change cause no settings re-render. A selected-setting change causes exactly one.
Provider events keep config.settings identity. A status-only delta reuses previous.models but always returns a new providers array.
Still open. The inbox model subscribes to config.providers by Object.is, so every provider delta changes inboxServerConfig and inboxEnvironments.

The model useMemo depends on props.environments. Each provider delta rebuilds buildInboxSidebarModel over all threads and creates new row objects, so every rendered InboxThreadRow (not virtualized) re-renders.
The only provider consumer in the inbox model is modelDisplayName (provider.models + driver). Status, auth, version, rateLimits and updateState changes do not affect it.

The default sidebarMode is 'inbox', so the open amplifier hits the default layout. The projects pane is memoized (SidebarProjectItem memo, stable renderProjectRow at Sidebar.tsx:1416) and is not affected.

Missed by the auditor. useAtomValue(serverConfigAtom) re-renders on every config push but only needs config presence and capabilities.projectIcons. It renders in every non-resting inbox row (InboxThreadRow.tsx:399,445 via InboxRowPreview.tsx:69-77) and every sidebar project header (SidebarProjectHeader.tsx:123). This was already there at f1be4abc7.
Whole-config useServerConfig(). Re-renders per inbox row with showMachine (InboxThreadRow.tsx:455) and per remote ThreadStatusIndicators (ThreadStatusIndicators.tsx:283). Only needs the machine kind.

Whole-config dependency. Every provider push rebuilds environments and calls notifyWebThreadPriorityEnvironmentsChanged(), which runs refreshAutomatic(onlyStale) and reschedules the periodic timer. It only needs capabilities.threadPriorityRanking.

Mitigating: since #710, persisted probe snapshots with a fresh fingerprint are adopted with no probe, so a normal boot sends few or no provider deltas. Stale fingerprints (server build, binary or settings change) still produce one delta per probed instance.
Provider changes are debounced by 200 ms, and providerStatusDelta.ts:70-76 drops no-op changes and omits unchanged catalogs.

remaining: 1) apps/web/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:458 selects config.providers with Object.is. Every providerStatusesDelta still rebuilds inboxEnvironments (Sidebar.tsx:466-591), so the whole inbox model is recomputed (InboxSidebar.tsx:123-157) and every rendered InboxThreadRow re-renders, in the default inbox mode. The model only reads driver and models (inboxSidebarModel.ts:592-604). 2) apps/web/src/components/ProjectFavicon.tsx:63 subscribes to the whole serverConfigAtom from every non-resting inbox row and every sidebar project header. 3) Smaller whole-config subscribers on the same path: DeviceIcon.tsx:29 (per row, when the machine is shown) and ThreadPriorityRefreshBridge.tsx:42, which re-runs the environmentsChanged refresh on every provider push. Since #710, provider pushes at boot are rare, so this cost appears mainly after updates, provider settings changes and explicit refreshes.
fixDefects: No correctness bugs in the useSettings or useSyncExternalStoreSelector implementation. Selectors that build objects (for example RootAppShell.tsx:252 projectGroupingSettings) do not loop, because selection is memoized per snapshot, and they re-render only on real settings changes. The auditor's call that the providers dependency is intended is too generous: status-only deltas cannot change any inbox output.
implementationSketch: 1) apps/web/src/rpc/serverState.ts:57: add an optional isEqual parameter to useServerConfigSelector and pass it to useSyncExternalStoreSelector. Add a primary-only variant, usePrimaryServerConfigSelector (same code without the settings-target branch, like useChatsAvailability.ts:46-50), and share the implementation. 2) inboxSidebarModel.ts: export sameInboxProviderCatalogs(a, b). It returns true when both are null, or when the lengths match and every index has the same instanceId, the same driver and the same models identity. In Sidebar.tsx:458, call useServerConfigSelector(selectServerProviders, sameInboxProviderCatalogs). Status-only deltas then keep the previous array and the inbox model is not rebuilt. Real catalog changes and snapshots still rebuild it. 3) ProjectFavicon.tsx:63: replace useAtomValue(serverConfigAtom) with usePrimaryServerConfigSelector(c => c === null ? null : c.environment.capabilities.projectIcons === true), and derive config == null and rpcSupported from that tri-state. Keep the saved-environment branch. 4) DeviceIcon.tsx:29: select a primitive, useServerConfigSelector(c => c ? resolveEnvironmentMachineKind(c) : null). 5) ThreadPriorityRefreshBridge.tsx:42: select the threadPriorityRanking boolean instead of the whole config. Optionally narrow RootAppShell EventRouter (line 260) to environment and cwd. Tests: unit-test sameInboxProviderCatalogs in inboxSidebarModel.test.ts. Extend useSettingsSubscriptions.browser.tsx with a Profiler probe using useServerConfigSelector(selectProviders, sameInboxProviderCatalogs): apply a status-only providerStatusesDelta through applyServerConfigEvent (models omitted) and expect no render; change a models catalog and expect one render. Add a ProjectFavicon profiler probe that does not re-render on applyProvidersUpdated. Run the focused web vitest and browser tests only.
decisionReason: Client-only render narrowing with no protocol, auth, hosted-lifecycle or behaviour change.
